Tools like Python do heavy math. Relax, practice on small datasets!","According to you, how can LLMs be used to innovate math learning in schools and universities?":"LLMs like ChatGPT can personalize math tutoring—explain at student's pace, generate practice problems, visualize concepts. Ethical: teach critical thinking.
